text:
QUOTE: "**Strings returned as `char*` belong to the caller.** Free them with `entropic_free()`." and "**Strings returned as `const char*` belong to the handle.** They stay valid until the next call on that handle. Do not free them."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both halves of the rule: `char*` is caller-owned and freed with `entropic_free`, and `const char*` is handle-owned and valid only until the next call on that handle.
